lede: Florida International carries the stronger underlying team rating — -3.8 against -5.2, a 1.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Florida Atlantic -3.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Florida Atlantic winning 58% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is run defense, where Florida International leads Florida Atlantic by 49 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
